newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-BREATHTAKING RONALDO SHINES AGAIN FOR BARCELONA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BREATHTAKING RONALDO SHINES AGAIN FOR BARCELONA.

text.p: Spanish newspapers were packed with praise for Barcelona's Brazilian striker Ronaldo on Monday after a weekend on which he once again swept all before him.
The country's journalists are fast running out of superlatives to describe the 20-year-old, who scored all three Barcelona goals in Saturday's 3-2 defeat of Valencia.
"A real exhibition of class, velocity and force," sports daily Marca said in one of the more restrained comments.
"Wanted: an antidote," appealed sports daily As, which asked Spanish club coaches what measures they would take to subdue the Brazilian.
"The only ones that occur to me are illegal," said Logrones coach Miguel Angel Lotina, whose side conceded two Ronaldo goals in their 8-0 drubbing by Barcelona last week.
The Brazilian is being credited with single-handedly boosting attendances at Nou Camp and nationwide TV ratings for Barcelona matches.

On Saturday Ronaldo won a game in which Bobby Robson's side deserved no more than a draw with a hat-trick of goals scored by picking up the ball in midfield and charging goalwards, shrugging off challenges.
Those three goals took Ronaldo's tally for his first season at Barcelona to 12. His strength, agility and balance in possession have already prompted comparisons with Diego Maradona at his prime.
